title: serverRoute
summary: Build browser-safe proxies for server handlers.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: path is the registered route pattern. module contains only browser-safe exports. handlers selects loader/action proxies; both default to true.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: A typed Route with remote handlers and optional client call-through.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Import this API from one of the entry points listed above. Keep server and build helpers in their dedicated subpaths.

sections.title: Behavior and edge cases
sections.body: Requests append .__smolter to the actual route pathname, preserving queries and mutation bodies. /admin/users?page=2 becomes /admin/users.__smolter?page=2. Vite and Node adapters share normalization. Explicit handlers.dataEndpoint retains the legacy query transport and must match the host configuration. Set loader/action flags explicitly when supplying options. JSON transport resolves data before returning; runtime input validation and authorization remain application-owned.
sections.code: serverRoute("/admin/users", browserModule, { loader: true, action: true });
